title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: One voice from the stands
hook: Your player hears three different instructions at once.
intro: A parent yells go, go, go.
statement: Kids freeze when the adults disagree out loud.
q1: Do you ask parents to cheer and not coach —
q2: or let it go and coach louder?
q3: How do you bring this up without making it personal?
t1: Every team is different. But players play freer
t2: when they hear one voice giving instructions.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle coaching from the stands?
ctaLines: A preseason note. A friendly word. Cheer only.
Address it early or wait until it is a problem?
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Your player hears three different instructions at once.
You say hold at second. A parent yells go, go, go.
Kids freeze when the adults disagree out loud.
Ask early or wait until it matters. There is no single right way.
How do you handle coaching from the stands? Share your habit in the comments.
